scope: CPU contract/ownership controls against observable synthetic native-shaped classes; actual startup timing/PMREM/image repeatability remains unverified.

cases.name: Actual receivers/arguments/return and one native ready draw are preserved; descriptors restored
Async native asset window sees stopped callback and cancelled RAF before Avatar resumes
Pre-hold native draw is retained and rejects rather than being erased
Native construction failures retain their original error and restore the observer
Zero/two ready draws cannot be labelled the native one-draw page history
Foreign published owner and changed motion/node clocks fail ready admission
Descriptor drift never overwrites a foreign draw owner during cleanup
Partial installation restores Stage if installing Avatar wrapper fails
Capture requires explicit manual creation and cannot be reused after admission
Bound HTML entry substitution preserves all other bytes and rejects ambiguity
